verdict.rationale: Generating component-level tests is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The pack shows AI-oriented tooling: llms.txt docs and an MCP server that supplies documentation and statically analyses generated Svelte code. It also documents reactive state primitives ($state, $derived, $effect). None of this evidence covers testing at all, let alone AI generation of tests from declared props or reactive state, so the verdict is none.
